EDGE RUSHAn arcade driving game by Gizmobyte
AndroidPortrait playSingle playerTap or swipe

Three lanes. One quick decision.

Find your rhythm
in the rush.

A short run can turn into a new personal best. The current beta brings together simple controls, close calls, and something to work toward.

01 /

Make the gap

Tap the left or right side of the screen, or swipe, to change lanes. Keep an eye on the traffic ahead.

02 /

Keep it close

Chain close calls to build their score bonus up to ×5. A replayable tutorial lets you learn by doing.

03 /

Make it yours

Collect coins toward car looks in the garage. Daily rewards and missions give your next run another goal.

Internal beta

A small game,
still taking shape.

Edge Rush is being prepared for Android distribution through TapTap International. There is no public download here yet. Current reward-ad screens are simulated for testing; live advertising is not connected.
